caption: The drawing primarily features a large wooden spoon depicted at the center, colored in two shades of brown to illustrate its concave bowl and handle. The spoon is oriented diagonally with the bowl facing up and to the right, and the handle extending to the bottom left. Surrounding the main image, there are three outlined sketches of the spoon’s cross-sections or details: at the top left is a horizontal view of the handle’s end, at the lower left is an overhead view of the spoon’s bowl, and at the right side is a side profile of the entire spoon showing its curved shape. All these surrounding sketches are presented in thin, grey pencil lines without any color fill. The drawing sits inside a rectangular border that echoes the shape of the paper, and the artist’s name, "Carl Keksi," is printed at the bottom right. The background is an off-white, lightly textured surface.
title: Spoon
